name: @praxis/verifier
description: Independent, pure-TypeScript (no WASM) implementation of object decode/CID/signature verification, run against spec/test-vectors/** to cross-check the Rust reference implementation (spec/PROTOCOL.md; docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md M1-09). If Rust and this disagree on a vector, that is a spec or implementation bug: do not special-case either side.
